title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - CosemOperationInput
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/CosemOperationInput. This class specifies the instance at which a service (get, set or action) is going to be executed by indicating the OBIS code. Subclass of oneM2M:OperationInput.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CosemOperationInput'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

obtainInputFromObis.description: Property. [COSEM] It identifies the instance (COSEM object) of a class from which the data is going to be obtained. The value of this property conforms to OBIS.
